title: End-to-End Credit Card Due Reminder to Collection Notification Workflow
description: Validates the complete lifecycle from automated due reminder to overdue alert and formal collection notification with correct card masking, UI flows, and system/audit triggers.
testDescription: Ensures all notifications (Reminder, Overdue, Collection) are sent according to business rules, only last four digits of card number are used, UI screens display correct masked data, state transitions occur, and audit trail is maintained.
prerequisites: Active cardholder, valid credit card (only last 4 digits exposed), payment due date set, test environment with notification and audit log settings enabled.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login to collection admin UI as bank operator. 2. Navigate to upcoming payment dashboard. 3. Confirm due reminder configuration for target cardholder. 4. Trigger automated due reminder for payment. 5. Check outbox for due reminder message with only last 4 digits visible. 6. Simulate missed payment (do not pay by due date). 7. Validate overdue alert is generated and delivered. 8. Confirm content includes overdue amount and masked card number. 9. Advance workflow to formal collection stage. 10. Send collection notification with extra charges. 11. Verify all notifications (UI, email/SMS/app) show only last 4 digits, never full card number. 12. Check workflow status in UI (Due → Overdue → Collection). 13. Validate audit trail entries for each stage transition and notification sent.
expectedResult: All notification types are delivered according to lifecycle. Only last 4 digits of card appear in any message. UI correctly reflects workflow stages. Audit trail logs every action. No full card number exposure observed.
businessRuleSource: Payment date triggers, missed payment triggers

title: PII Exposure Edge Case Validation: Notification Content Never Contains Full Card Number
description: Ensures notifications, UI screens, API payloads, and external handoffs never display or transmit the full card number at any stage of lifecycle; only last 4 digits allowed.
testDescription: Simulate scenarios where full card number could be exposed due to misconfiguration, UI bug, or integration error. Validate masking in all communications, test error handling, and ensure regulatory compliance.
prerequisites: Test cardholder with valid credit card, access to config settings, ability to manipulate notification templates and integration endpoints.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login as collection admin and navigate to notification config. 2. Edit reminder template to deliberately insert full card number field. 3. Trigger due reminder to cardholder. 4. Monitor message outbox and UI screen for card number display. 5. Integrate with collection agency API simulating payload with full card number. 6. Attempt handoff to agency and intercept payload. 7. Check audit logs for any full card number exposure. 8. Validate error handling and system warnings triggered. 9. Run formal collection notification with modified content. 10. Review legal documentation and ensure only last 4 digits are present. 11. Test rollback and recovery procedures if exposure detected.
expectedResult: No notification, UI, external transmission, or document ever displays or transmits full card number. System triggers error and logs attempt. Regulatory compliance maintained.

title: Boundary Value and State Transition Analysis for Monetary Fields and Workflow Advancement
description: Tests all monetary fields at boundaries (zero, minimum, maximum, negative, extremely large) and validates correct state transition logic from due reminder through overdue, collection, agency handoff, and legal escalation.
testDescription: Boundary values for balance and overdue triggers are injected and tested for correct notification, UI rendering, workflow status, audit log, and error handling.
prerequisites: Cardholder account with adjustable balance and status, test environment that accepts boundary values.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login to admin UI and set cardholder balance to zero. 2. Trigger due reminder and validate notification sent (last 4 digits only). 3. Set overdue to minimum positive value; simulate missed payment. 4. Check overdue alert sent and status update. 5. Set account balance to maximum allowed value and repeat notification workflow. 6. Inject negative balance and confirm system error handling, no notification sent. 7. Apply extremely large balance (boundary overflow) and test workflow advancement and notification. 8. Move account to collection stage for each boundary case. 9. Validate UI status, audit logs, notification content, and rollback behavior for each transition. 10. Confirm agency handoff and legal escalation only occur at correct thresholds.
expectedResult: Notifications and workflow transitions function correctly for all boundary values. No negative or out-of-bound values accepted. Audit logs capture all changes. System handles reversal and errors gracefully.
ASSUMPTION: Boundary values are permitted in test

title: Payment Plan Proposal and Negotiation with Multiple State Changes and Reversal
description: Validate structured payment plan workflow, UI review, notification generation, integration, and reversal if cardholder pays off balance early, with strict masking on notifications.
testDescription: Cardholder receives formal collection notice, triggers payment plan proposal, negotiates terms, accepts plan, system reflects new status, and verifies reversal workflow if balance settled before completion. Integrates UI and notification content checks.
prerequisites: Cardholder in collection status with overdue balance, payment plan feature enabled in UI, notification templates set.
stepsToPerform: 1. Bank operator logs into UI and navigates to collection dashboard. 2. Triggers payment plan proposal for cardholder. 3. Reviews and confirms structured repayment terms in UI. 4. Sends proposal notification (last 4 digits only). 5. Cardholder reviews plan and accepts terms within app. 6. System advances workflow to payment plan status; records status in UI. 7. Sends confirmation notification to cardholder. 8. Cardholder makes early lump sum payment in app. 9. System reverses from payment plan to closed status. 10. Sends closure notification (last 4 digits only), updates audit trail. 11. Validates all transitions and notifications do not expose full card number.
expectedResult: Payment plan workflow proceeds with notification masking, UI state changes, and audit logs. Early payment reversal handled correctly with all communication properly masked.
businessRuleSource: Overdue triggers, plan eligibility, early payment

title: Error Handling and Audit Trail Validation for Integration Failures (Notification & Legal Document Generation)
description: Simulate and verify error scenarios involving failure to send notifications, integration API errors with collection agency, and legal documentation generation failure. Validate rollback and audit trail completeness.
testDescription: Negative and edge cases for failed notifications, lost agency integration, and legal document generation are tested for proper error alerts, UI indicators, and thorough logging. Ensures regulatory visibility and recovery options.
prerequisites: Test accounts at overdue and collection stage, ability to simulate notification and API failures, legal document generator endpoint accessible.
stepsToPerform: 1. Set cardholder status to overdue. 2. Attempt to send overdue alert; simulate notification delivery failure. 3. Validate UI alert and audit log entry for failure. 4. Move workflow to collection agency handoff. 5. Simulate agency API integration failure. 6. Confirm error message in UI and audit log. 7. Initiate legal escalation and attempt document generation; force generation failure. 8. Check UI alert, error logging, and rollback availability. 9. Attempt manual recovery for each failed step. 10. Validate all communication includes only last 4 digits of card and no full number regardless of failure. 11. Review audit trail for completeness and traceability.
expectedResult: All failures are properly handled in UI and logged. No full card number exposure regardless of error. System supports recovery actions and maintains complete audit trail.

title: Role-Based Access Control and Approval Workflow for Collection Lifecycle Notifications
description: Validate that only authorized roles (bank operator, supervisor) can view, create, modify, and approve notification templates and trigger workflows at each collection stage with regulatory compliance.
testDescription: Ensures various user roles have correct UI access to notification creation, editing, review, approval, and triggering for reminders, overdue, collection, payment plan, agency handoff, and legal documents. Validates that only last 4 digits of card number are used, includes audit trail for all user actions.
prerequisites: Test environment set with collection admin, supervisor, compliance officer roles; collection workflow enabled; user accounts mapped to roles; notification template editor available.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login as collection admin and access notification creation UI. 2. Attempt to edit reminder template and trigger preview message. 3. Switch role to supervisor, approve template change. 4. Send test notification, confirm message log includes only last 4 digits. 5. Attempt unauthorized access with teller role to workflow stage; validate access is denied. 6. Trigger overdue alert workflow as supervisor. 7. Approve escalation to collection notification; confirm approval recorded in audit trail. 8. Initiate payment plan proposal; confirm only authorized roles can view/approve. 9. Attempt handoff to collection agency as compliance officer; validate approval flow and audit log. 10. Initiate legal documentation generation as compliance officer; approve and log action.
expectedResult: Role-based actions are permitted as designed. Unauthorized users blocked from modification/triggering. Audit logs capture every approval, modification, and escalation. All notifications contain only masked card number.
notificationType: Reminder, Overdue, Collection, Payment Plan, Agency, Legal
businessRuleSource: Access control rules, approval workflow policy
role: Collection Admin, Supervisor, Compliance Officer, Teller
ASSUMPTION: Approval workflow enforced; roles correctly provisioned

title: Multi-Missed Payment Journey with Dynamic Notification Triggers and State Reversal Validation
description: Validate system behavior and notification logic for repeated missed payments across cycles, including state transitions, late fee calculations, UI updates, and reversal to normal status once payment is made after escalation.
testDescription: Test cardholder missing consecutive payments, triggering overdue/collection notifications, system applying late fees, masks card number in all alerts, then reversing workflow from collection to normal upon full payment. Ensures correct calculations, UI changes, and audit logs.
prerequisites: Account setup with recurring payment due dates, ability to simulate missed payments and subsequent payment, notification and fee calculation engine enabled.
stepsToPerform: 1. Set cardholder account with upcoming due date and valid card. 2. Trigger due reminder notification (last 4 digits only). 3. Simulate first missed payment, system sends overdue alert. 4. Apply late fee, validate fee computation and notification content. 5. Simulate second missed payment; escalate to collection stage. 6. Send formal collection notification (masked card number, all charges). 7. Cardholder submits delinquent payment covering all balances. 8. System reverses workflow from collection to normal 'current' status. 9. Confirm closure notification sent and audit log of reversal. 10. Validate UI status updates appropriately for state changes and reversal.
expectedResult: Notifications for all missed payment stages are sent with correct content/PII masking. Fees computed and reported accurately. Workflow reversal to normal status functions as intended, with full audit trace.
businessRuleSource: Missed payment triggers, late fee calculation, payment reversal
auditTrailValidation: All missed payments, fees, and reversal logged
ASSUMPTION: Multiple missed payments and reversal permitted

title: Integration and Notification Content Validation with Third-Party Collection Agency API Handoff
description: Validate that when workflow advances to collection agency handoff, notification and API payloads only include masked card number and required data, supporting PCI DSS and data privacy compliance.
testDescription: Simulates workflow advance to collection agency stage, validates API integration, ensures payload includes only last 4 digits of card number, overdue amount, and allowable PII, verifies received notification content, and audit logging.
prerequisites: Cardholder in overdue or collection state, agency API endpoint available, staging environment, bank operator access.
stepsToPerform: 1. Move targeted cardholder to collection stage in admin UI. 2. Initiate agency handoff workflow. 3. Review API payload for outgoing handoff; verify only last 4 digits present. 4. Validate notification content sent to agency and cardholder. 5. Confirm agency platform logs receipt of correct masked data. 6. Attempt manual API call with full card number; expect rejection or error log. 7. Review UI for agency workflow handoff status. 8. Validate audit logs for handoff initiation and all data shared. 9. Monitor for any regulatory breach alerts, system warnings.
expectedResult: API payload and notifications only include permitted PII (masked card number). External agency confirms correct receipt. Audit logs fully track handoff. System blocks/reports non-compliant attempts.
businessRuleSource: API integration, PCI DSS, workflow triggers
auditTrailValidation: Agency handoff and API data logged
ASSUMPTION: Agency permits only masked card number

title: Notification Trigger and Content Validation for Invalid Card Numbers Across All Stages
description: Verify the system rejects workflows with invalid card numbers (incorrect length, non-numeric, full card number exposure) at any notification stage and ensures error handling and audit logging.
testDescription: Tests negative scenarios where invalid card numbers are entered at reminder, overdue, collection, payment plan, agency, and legal stages. Ensures notifications are not sent, error is surfaced, masking logic is enforced, audit logs are generated.
prerequisites: Test cardholder records with invalid card number variants, notification workflows enabled.
stepsToPerform: 1. Edit cardholder record to input invalid card number (too short). 2. Attempt to trigger due reminder notification. 3. Confirm UI blocks trigger and displays error. 4. Input non-numeric card number and repeat overdue alert trigger. 5. Validate error handling and audit log entry. 6. Input full card number and attempt collection notification; verify masking logic prevents exposure. 7. Attempt agency handoff with invalid card payload; agency API rejects and system logs error. 8. Initiate legal documentation for invalid card number; confirm rejection and log. 9. Review audit log for all failed triggers and masking enforcement.
expectedResult: Workflows reject invalid card numbers at all stages. System surfaces clear errors, blocks notifications, and logs all attempts for compliance.
notificationType: Reminder, Overdue, Collection, Payment Plan, Agency, Legal
cardNumberMasking: Error for invalid, block full card exposure
alertSeverity: Critical for PII breach, High for validation errors
auditTrailValidation: All failed triggers and masking enforcement logged
ASSUMPTION: Invalid card numbers can be input for testing

title: Legal Action Initiation and Compliance Audit for Notification Structure, Documentation, and UI Flow
description: Validate entire process for legal escalation including notification content, UI review, automated document generation, PII masking, approval workflow, and regulatory audit requirements.
testDescription: Simulates end-to-end initiation of legal escalation for extreme delinquency: reviews notification UI, triggers legal action, validates documentation masks card number, tests approval flow and audit logging for compliance officers.
prerequisites: Cardholder in extreme collection delinquency status, legal action workflow enabled, compliance officer role, document generation engine available.
stepsToPerform: 1. Set cardholder account to legal escalation status in admin dashboard. 2. Initiate legal action from UI workflow. 3. Review legal notification preview screen; ensure last 4 digits only. 4. Trigger document generation; validate output includes only masked card number. 5. Route generated documents for compliance officer approval. 6. Approve legal action and log decision in audit system. 7. Send final notification to cardholder (masked card). 8. Store legal documents in secure repository; validate access rules. 9. Review audit log for all legal workflow actions, PII masking, and document history.
expectedResult: Legal notification and documentation processes use only masked card number, approvals and audit logs are complete, access controls for documents enforced.
businessRuleSource: Legal escalation criteria, PCI DSS, audit compliance
integrationPlatform: Legal Doc Generator, UI, Secure Storage, Audit Log
ASSUMPTION: Legal action workflow enabled and document storage compliant

title: Dynamic Due Reminder Reconfiguration and Notification Retesting with Date Adjustment
description: Validates ability to reconfigure payment due dates, retrigger reminders, and verify content masking and audit log integrity after schedule change.
testDescription: Check system flexibility for rescheduling due reminders, ensuring only masked card number appears in all retriggered notifications and audit trail reflects date and content changes.
prerequisites: Active cardholder account, collection dashboard access, notification template editor enabled.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login as collection admin to collection workflow UI. 2. Locate cardholder scheduled for credit card payment due. 3. Edit upcoming payment due date to a new value. 4. Save schedule and verify UI updates. 5. Retrigger automated due reminder notification. 6. Check notification outbox to confirm updated date and content uses only last 4 digits of card. 7. Verify audit trail logs date change and notification retrigger. 8. Attempt to review the previous reminder; confirm historical masking and audit. 9. Confirm that no duplicate notifications are generated for same period.
expectedResult: Notification for new due date includes only masked card number, audit trail logs all changes, UI shows correct schedule, and no duplicate reminders are sent.
auditTrailValidation: Schedule changes, retrigger, and masking logged
ASSUMPTION: Due date can be modified for testing

title: Duplicate Notification Prevention and Audit Validation for Multiple Trigger Attempts
description: Ensures system prevents sending duplicate notifications for the same event and audits attempts, confirming regulatory compliance and masking.
testDescription: Simulate scenarios where bank operator attempts to trigger overdue alert multiple times within same period; verify that system blocks duplicates, logs attempt, and notification masking remains enforced.
prerequisites: Overdue cardholder record, notification engine enabled, operator access.
stepsToPerform: 1. Cardholder misses payment, triggering overdue status. 2. Operator initiates overdue alert from UI. 3. Confirm alert sent and content includes only last 4 digits. 4. Attempt to resend overdue alert within restricted period. 5. System should display error or warning; block operation. 6. Check notification outbox for duplicate prevention outcome. 7. Attempt via alternate workflow (API/manual retry); expect same blocking behavior. 8. Review audit trail for both initial and duplicate attempts. 9. Validate no full card number exposure on failed attempts.
expectedResult: System prevents duplicate overdue alerts, logs all attempts, and maintains PII masking, supporting audit and compliance requirements.

title: Audit Review and Notification Tracking Across Multiple Channels
description: Validates audit trail completeness and notification delivery tracking for simultaneous multi-channel communication (email, SMS, app), with correct masking and UI reconciliation.
testDescription: Ensure that reminders, overdue, collection, and payment plan notifications sent simultaneously across multiple channels are audit-logged, masked, and UI allows reconciliation/review.
prerequisites: Cardholder enrolled for email, SMS, and app notifications; admin and compliance access.
stepsToPerform: 1. Set cardholder to overdue status with payment plan proposal eligibility. 2. Trigger overdue alert and payment plan proposal across email, SMS, and app simultaneously. 3. Access notification logs in admin UI for each channel. 4. Validate delivery status for all channels and check content masking (last 4 digits only). 5. Attempt to review sent notifications in audit trail. 6. Confirm audit log entries for each channel and notification type. 7. Access UI reconciliation dashboard; verify cross-channel status mapping. 8. Check failed delivery logs if any channel is offline. 9. Reattempt delivery after fixing channel issue; validate audit logs record new attempts.
expectedResult: Multi-channel notifications are delivered or logged with proper masking, audit entries are complete and cross-referenceable, UI reconciliation displays all channel statuses.

title: Data Refresh and Overwrite Validation Post Payment and Collection Agency Handoff
description: Tests system behavior when payments are made after agency handoff, ensuring workflow reversal, notification, updated audit trail, and no PII breach.
testDescription: Simulates cardholder making payment after handoff to collection agency, validates workflow return, notification masking, agency update, and full audit log.
prerequisites: Account at agency collection stage, cardholder enabled for payment portal, agency API integration live.
stepsToPerform: 1. Move cardholder to agency handoff workflow in UI. 2. Trigger notification and API handoff to agency; validate masking. 3. Cardholder makes partial or full payment via app or portal. 4. System updates balance, recalculates overdue/charges, refreshes workflow status. 5. Retrigger closure notification and confirm masking. 6. Send agency update notification about payment and status reversal. 7. Check agency API for new status and masked card number. 8. Review admin UI for workflow rollback from agency to normal/closed. 9. Validate audit trail for payment, reversal, notification, agency status update.
expectedResult: Payment post-agency handoff triggers workflow reversal, updates UI/status, all notifications contain only last 4 digits, audit logs complete, agency receives compliant update.

title: Multi-Stage Notification Failure Simulation with Manual Recovery and Compliance Checks
description: Simulates notification delivery failures at multiple workflow stages (due reminder, overdue, collection, legal) and tests manual recovery, content masking, regulatory compliance, and complete audit trace.
testDescription: Proactively simulate failures in sending notifications for each lifecycle stage; validate manual recovery, ensure masking, and confirm all actions are audit-logged.
prerequisites: Test environment with failure simulation tools and admin access.
stepsToPerform: 1. Prepare cardholder records for each stage (due, overdue, collection, legal). 2. Initiate due reminder notification and induce delivery failure. 3. Attempt manual resend or alternate channel delivery; verify masking. 4. Advance workflow to overdue stage; repeat failure simulation. 5. Escalate to collection notification, simulate delivery failure. 6. Trigger legal documentation and notification; induce failure again. 7. Manually review recovery logs and audit for each stage. 8. Confirm no full card number exposed in any communication, recovery, or audit entry. 9. Validate regulatory compliance notices are generated for repeated failures.
expectedResult: System logs notification failures at each stage, allows manual recovery/resend, all communication stays masked, audit log is exhaustive, compliance alerts issued as appropriate.
